questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ville gerne et sted hen, hvor der var strand og godt vej

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: UAB har været gode til at svare på mails, så det gjorde det hele meget nemt.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Man modtog en masse information inden vi ankom, så der var ikke behov for særlig meget hjælp udover det. Derudover kunne man søge en "mentor". Jeg brugte min til at vise mig rundt på campus og hvis man havde andre spørgsmål, som andre lokale studerende er bedre til at svare på.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Lejede igennem AirBnb.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det kan være dyrt, så være ude i god tid. Jeg synes det var rart at bo i centrum, hvor man er tæt på alt. Ved at dem der boede på campus havde svært ved altid at komme hjem om natten, men hvis man gerne vil møde en masse lokale og internationale studerende er on-campus sikkert en god løsning.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: De sender mails ud til en, hvor man får en dato når kurserne kan søges. Man søger online - nemt og hurtigt.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kan altid skive en mail, men der kan godt gå lidt tid før de svarer - og særligt i ferier, så vær tålmodig. Skriv hellere i løbet af semestret, så du ved, at der ikke er ferie og andet, som gør, at svartiden bliver lang.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Fik alle dem jeg ville have.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Bare søg nogle fag, der er mulighed for at skifte når man først er hernede. Så hvis man ender på et fag, som viser sig at være noget helt andet, så kan man skifte (hvis der er ledige pladser)

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Hvis man gerne vil have det nemmere fagligt, så er Barcelona generelt et godt sted sammenliget med KU

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det er nemmere end på KU. Man bliver vurderet løbende, da der både kan være prøver undervejs, en midtvejsevaluering samt en afsluttende eksamen.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det er meget gymnasieagtigt, hvor man sidder i et klasselokale, og hvor underviseren gennemgår slides (som man kender det fra KU).

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Fag jeg selv tog: 

Economic Development: Overføres til Economic Development (det er et yderst nemt fag at bestå).
Business Economics I: Overføres som et nabofag (der er en del deltagelse i løbet af semestret, men eksamenerne er nemme).
Economic Policy: Overføres til Macroeconomics III (det er nemt at bestå på UAB).
Microeconomics III: Overføres som et økonomisk valgfag (minder om Microeconomics II).
World Economic History: Overføres til Økonomisk historie (et nemt fag).

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Vil anbefale alle pånær Microeconomics III, da det minder meget om mikro 2

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er mulighed for både sport, aktiviteter og sociale arrangementer. Der er rigtig gode muligheder for at møde nye mennesker.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Klubber, fitness og mentor-ordninger.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tag på en masse udflugter. Vi var bl.a. i Marrakech og tog på længere udflugter i Spanien.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag på udflugter og nyd byen.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Meld dig til arrangement, ind i klubber eller vær god til at socialisere dig med de lokale på dine hold.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ingen

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Det hele er lidt mere roligt og at man ikke har så travlt.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Nyd det, vær åben og brug byen/landet så meget du kan.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Forelske mig i by og møde verdens bedste venner

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Ved det ikke.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Nej.

questions.answer: Yes
